answer: A practical defence is SIM-based identity via eSIM profile proof. It rests on an eSIM profile that only one phone holds, which gives every honest agent a kernel that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since an eSIM profile that only one phone holds takes calendar time as well as money — and the vine is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the wharf cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
